name: Native Ethernet
description: LAN1/br-lan to standalone LAN4; untagged on both test links.

name: Tagged ingress on LAN1
description: VLAN 103 upper on LAN1; its parent remains in br-lan. LAN4 stays native.

name: Standalone LAN4 VLAN
description: Native LAN1 to standalone lan4.104; VID 104 is tagged on the LAN4 link.

name: Tagged bridge VLAN
description: LAN4 is a tagged member of a VLAN-filtering bridge; L3 is on br-vtest.104.

name: Untagged bridge access port
description: LAN4 is untagged access/PVID 104; L3 remains on br-vtest.104.

name: Native Ethernet to 5 GHz AP
description: Native LAN1 to built-in 5 GHz AP and wrt station; QCN9074 station is outside this payload path.

name: Tagged Ethernet to native Wi-Fi
description: LAN1 carries tagged VID 103; the built-in AP and station use the native network.

name: Standalone AP VLAN
description: Native LAN1 to the standalone phy0-ap0.104 upper; VID 104 crosses the AP/STA link.

name: Tagged AP bridge VLAN
description: AP is a tagged VID 104 bridge member; L3 terminates on br-wtest.104.

name: Untagged AP access/PVID
description: AP and bridge SELF use PVID 104 untagged; IP is on br-wtest itself, unlike T4.

name: Two native WLANs
description: The 2.4 GHz and built-in 5 GHz WLANs are separate routed networks; no Ethernet payload leg.

name: Tagged left AP upper
description: Tagged VLAN 103 on the 2.4 GHz AP upper whose parent is in a dedicated bridge; the right AP stays native.

name: Standalone right AP VLAN
description: Native 2.4 GHz AP to standalone 5 GHz AP VLAN 104. One software-mode SNAT TCP timeout was retained in the extension.

name: Tagged right AP bridge VLAN
description: Right AP is a tagged VID 104 bridge member; L3 is on the bridge VLAN upper.

name: Right AP access/PVID
description: Right AP data is untagged PVID 104 while L3 is on br-dvright.104. Final access-layout rekey/reassociation was not qualified.

name: Ethernet–Wi-Fi bridge control
description: LAN1 and the built-in AP share one bridge domain; payload uses L2 forwarding without IP routing or NAT.
